selection_method: DESYNPUF_ID sorted lexicographically ascending, filtered to beneficiaries present in BOTH the 2008 Beneficiary Summary file and at least one claim in both the Inpatient and Outpatient Sample 1 files (36314 such beneficiaries exist), first 15 taken. This exercises all three selected source tables (Beneficiary Summary, Inpatient Claims, Outpatient Claims) and the multi-diagnosis/procedure/HCPCS wide-to-normalized transform without requiring a full 116k-beneficiary load for development and tests. This is a development selection for testing the ETL pipeline, not a representative population sample.
